title: [GMCP 203.022.M] Mastery: Namespacing, routing, composition, and virtual capabilities
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-022-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: Stable globally unique capability identities prevent collisions and shadowing across servers, aliases remain explicit, and routing can select or fan out by schema, policy, health, locality and cost. Typed compositions form virtual tools/resources/prompts with provenance, transaction and compensation semantics, cycle detection, bounded depth, deterministic plans, and no privilege amplification between steps. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
